introduction.value: Test suite for the ChibiOS/XHAL Crypto driver. The general sequence checks the driver and API behavior, the other sequences check each algorithm against published test vectors. Algorithms not supported by the driver under test are skipped.

description.value: Driver lifecycle, capabilities, transient key handling, stream lifecycle and concurrency, independent of the algorithm.
The driver is started, stopped and restarted.

local_variables.value: msg_t msg;

description.value: Starting the driver, READY state is expected.
Stopping the driver, STOP state is expected.
Restarting the driver, READY state is expected.
Every algorithm is queried; supported algorithms report capability flags, unsupported ones report CRY_ERR_UNSUPPORTED with cleared capabilities.
Querying all algorithms and printing the supported ones.
Loading the transient key, invalid key parameters, a missing key and loading a key held by a stream.
Selecting a supported AES cipher, the test is skipped if there is none.
Beginning a stream before any key is loaded, CRY_ERR_KEY is expected.
Loading an AES key with an invalid size, CRY_ERR_ARGUMENT is expected.

code.value: msg = xcry_load_key(CRY_KEY_AES, 12U, key); test_assert(msg == CRY_ERR_ARGUMENT, "invalid key accepted");

description.value: Loading an AES-128 key and beginning a stream, success is expected.
Loading the key while the stream holds it, CRY_ERR_BUSY is expected.

code.value: msg = xcry_load_key(CRY_KEY_AES, sizeof key, key); test_assert(msg == CRY_ERR_BUSY, "held key replaced");

description.value: Aborting the stream then loading the key again, success is expected.
A stream open across drvStop() is invalidated and the transient key is erased.
Selecting a supported AES cipher, the test is skipped if there is none.
Loading a key and beginning a stream, success is expected.
Restarting the driver with the stream open, aborting the invalidated stream is expected to be harmless.
Beginning a stream on the erased transient key, CRY_ERR_KEY is expected.
Loading the key again, a new stream is expected to begin.
Two hash streams are open at once; the second either begins, and both produce correct digests, or is refused with CRY_ERR_BUSY.
Selecting a supported hash, the test is skipped if there is none.
Beginning two streams, the second is allowed to be busy.
Interleaving updates and finalizing, the digests are expected to match.
Aborting finalized, idle and active contexts.
Selecting a supported hash, the test is skipped if there is none.
Aborting an active stream then a finalized one, a new stream on the same context is expected to work.
Beginning a stream for an algorithm the driver does not support is expected to return CRY_ERR_UNSUPPORTED.
Loading an AES key, when possible, so that key errors do not hide unsupported algorithms.

code.value: (void) xcry_load_key(CRY_KEY_AES, sizeof key, key);

description.value: Beginning streams for all unsupported stream algorithms.
